unit_types.name: UnitType0_Peasant
unit_types.evidence: The unit-name pointer table base entry is "peon" (g_UnitSpriteFolders), which feeds sprite paths like units_go/peon?.s32, and scripting APIs expose IloscChlopow/WyprowadzChlopow for counting/dispatching peasants.

unit_types.name: UnitType13_Hero
unit_types.evidence: Type id 13 is excluded from melee/ranged routines and special-cased in menus, indicating a unique hero/queen unit.

unit_types.name: RangedUnitCategory
unit_types.evidence: Only types with byte_512582 != 0 execute the projectile logic in sub_437630 and rely on ranged stat formulas.

unit_types.name: ImmobileOrGarrisoned
unit_types.evidence: Flag bit0 in dword_51257A marks units skipped by movement/highlight code, implying static garrison units.

unit_types.name: DefaultFieldUnit
unit_types.evidence: Any type with byte_51257E > 0 and flag bit0 cleared participates in melee, consumes action points, and uses morale/veterancy multipliers.

unit_types.name: LightUnitCategory
unit_types.evidence: dword_51257A bit1 marks light units whose veterancy cap is set to 6 in sub_41E7B0 instead of the default 10.

unit_types.name: PeonWorker
unit_types.evidence: The UI name builder uses ( &off_51256C )[22 * type ] and the zeroth entry is the literal "peon", identifying type id 0 as the worker/peon.

stats.name: action_points
stats.semantic_role: per-turn stamina consumed by melee/move actions
stats.evidence: Initialized from byte_512580 during slot creation and decremented each time sub_428400 executes an attack.

stats.name: morale_percent
stats.semantic_role: percent modifier applied to every attack/defense computation
stats.evidence: Field +9 always starts at 100 and multiplies the outputs of sub_411120/sub_411280/sub_4112F0.

stats.name: veterancy
stats.semantic_role: experience bonus added before morale scaling
stats.evidence: sub_40F440 seeds offset +11 with 6 or 10 based on dword_51257A bit1 and the value feeds into all stat formulas as /5 or /10 increments.

stats.name: base_melee_attack
stats.semantic_role: core melee attack rating per type
stats.evidence: byte_51257E is read in sub_411120/UI_IconIndexFromStats to compute attack value and gates melee eligibility in sub_428400.

stats.name: base_secondary_attack
stats.evidence: byte_51257F feeds sub_4111C0 and the projectile hit-cost calculation in sub_4295D0 when byte_512582 marks ranged capability.

stats.name: base_damage_scalar
stats.semantic_role: raw damage magnitude before morale/veterancy multiplier
stats.evidence: sub_411280 and sub_4112C0 read byte_512581 to compute inflicted HP values.

stats.name: structure_damage_scalar
stats.semantic_role: alternate damage table used when attacking fortifications/buildings
stats.evidence: sub_4112F0 adds byte_512584 and veteranship before morale scaling when the caller passes the building-context flag.

stats.name: road_move_cost
stats.evidence: sub_413DD0 returns byte_512585 when the map tile stores a road index (v11[2] != 0xFFFF).

stats.name: terrain_move_cost
stats.evidence: sub_413DD0 and the dword_524568 lookup combine byte_512586 with tile-type offsets to enforce penalties across grass, mud, etc.

stats.name: unit_flags
stats.evidence: dword_51257A bit0 marks immobile/garrison units while bit1 marks light units with reduced veterancy caps.

stats.name: attack_range_max
stats.evidence: sub_4287E0 compares distance against byte_512582[88 * type] before allowing ranged attacks.

stats.name: attack_range_min
stats.evidence: The same range check requires distance to exceed byte_512583 entries, proving certain units have a close-range dead zone.

stats.name: sprite_height
stats.evidence: byte_512577 feeds the portrait renderer so selection frames and morale bars align per unit sprite height.

stats.name: move_pixel_speed
stats.evidence: Movement loops multiply byte_512570 by direction vectors to advance dword_523F70/74 while stepping across tiles.

stats.name: move_tick_delay
stats.evidence: `Time_Now` compares against byte_512571 before emitting the next movement frame in sub_38680.

stats.name: death_animation_frames
stats.semantic_role: number of frames in a unit’s death/explosion effect
stats.evidence: byte_512578 is copied to dword_512364 and the death loop decrements a frame counter until it reaches zero.

stats.name: death_frame_interval
stats.evidence: byte_512572 sets the `Time_Now` threshold before the next explosion frame increments dword_523F7C.

relationships.evidence: Hero type 13 is prevented from calling melee/ranged handlers, so its stamina and attack stats are never decremented (clash95.c:49182-49270).
Projectile cost/strength derives from byte_51257F whenever the type has a non-zero attack range (clash95.c:40440-40465, 49182-49270).
Units flagged with dword_51257A bit0 skip sub_415EA0 path highlight and therefore do not consume movement costs (clash95.c:27660-27695, 42290-42310).
Standard melee resolves only when byte_51257E for the attacking type is non-zero and consumes action_points accordingly (clash95.c:39680-39760).
sub_4287E0 compares squared distance against byte_512582 entries before allowing a projectile to fire (clash95.c:39803-39820).
The same routine requires distance to exceed byte_512583 entries, proving certain ranged units have dead zones (clash95.c:39803-39820).
sub_41E7B0 caps light-unit veterancy at 6 while heavy/default units can reach 10 (clash95.c:32950-32970).
